parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the returned page.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing seconds.

parameters.name: OnlyAiEvt
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only events detected by AI.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: `asc` (ascending) and `desc` (descending).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: SensitiveLevel
parameters.description: The sensitivity level of the data in the event.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing seconds.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The unique ID of the event.
